item.title: Asean’s neutrality set to be tested as Philippines welcomes world leaders
item.description: World leaders converged in Manila for the Asean summit on Sunday, bringing attention to the 11-member bloc’s growing clout in a region with a population of 700 million and a US$4.4 trillion economy that is tipped to become the world’s fourth largest by 2030. Among top officials flying in are Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, Chinese Premier Li Qiang and US President Donald Trump, with the latter expected to attend on Tuesday . But questions... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: UK government to consider changing age of consent after allegations against Russell Brand
item.description: Deputy prime minister says change would be a massive step but ‘deserves proper consideration and scrutiny’ The government has said it will consider calls to change the age of consent after a woman waived her right to anonymity to publicly claim she was raped by Russell Brand as a 16-year-old schoolgirl. Mia Latter, now 37, alleged she had been orally raped by the jailed comedian when she was a teenager and he was 30 years old. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Malaysia’s Melaka poll shows ethnic lines firming. Can Anwar turn Malay nationalist tide?
item.description: Identity politics could very well decide the outcome of Malaysia’s next national election, experts say, after parties and voters dug in their heels along ethnic lines in recent polls that have undermined Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s multicultural ruling coalition. On Saturday, Anwar’s Pakatan Harapan (PH) suffered its third straight electoral defeat this year in Melaka state as the incumbent Barisan Nasional (BN) coalition and its new partner, the Perikatan Nasional (PN) federal opposition... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Amid the Xi-Trump clamour, can Apec revive the business of cooperation?
item.description: The 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit will be held in Shenzhen from November 18 to 19. The venue is not accidental. Forty years ago, this was a border town of rice fields and duck ponds; it is now where a good part of the world’s electronics are designed and built, and the showcase of China’s “reform and opening up”. The event’s theme, “Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together”, puts openness, innovation and cooperation at the centre. US President Donald Trump... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Aparecen millones de dólares enterrados en un bosque durante la investigación a un exministro de Orbán en Hungría
item.description: La nueva autoridad anticorrupción de Hungría, creada en agosto y dirigida por Anna Róza Unger, acaba de dar un sonado primer golpe contra la jerarquía de las legislaturas del ex primer ministro Viktor Orbán . Durante la investigación contra Miklós Sesták, ex ministro de Desarrollo Nacional, ha dado con 18 millones de dólares en metálico, buena parte de los cuales estaban enterrados en el bosque.La mayor parte del dinero estaba en forma de billetes de dólares estadounidenses, aunque también hay paquetes de euros y de florines húngaros. Todos los fondos incautados fueron transferidos al Tesoro… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Honduras borra grafitis de pandillas que delimitan zonas de influencia
item.description: La Policía hondureña está borrando los grafitis de pandillas en barrios de Tegucigalpa controlados por grupos criminales. En Honduras operan las pandillas Mara Salvatrucha (MS-13) y Barrio 18, rivales entre sí, que suelen pintar sus iniciales en las fachadas para delimitar sus zonas de influencia. La eliminación de estos símbolos forma parte de la estrategia del presidente Nasry Asfura. Sin embargo, los vecinos se muestran escépticos ante la posibilidad de que esta medida mejore la seguridad o reduzca el control de las pandillas. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.description: Este 14 de noviembre, el Gobierno del presidente colombiano Abelardo de la Espriella está a punto de cumplir 100 días en el poder. Su proyecto, denominado "Patria Milagro", ha estado marcado por una agenda conservadora en defensa de la familia tradicional y por cuestionamientos sobre la libertad de expresión y los derechos sexuales y reproductivos. En materia de seguridad, persisten las dudas sobre la estrategia para combatir a los grupos armados y las organizaciones narcotraficantes. item.title: Andy Burnham says UK has ‘lost more than we gained’ through Brexit
item.description: PM accuses Tories of burning ‘all our bridges’ and says deal he is pursuing with EU will ‘get food prices down’ Andy Burnham has said the UK has “lost more than we gained” since leaving the EU, the prime minister’s latest in a string of comments criticising Brexit. Outlining his desire to form closer ties with Brussels, Burnham accused the Conservative party of having “burned all our bridges” with the bloc after Brexit and said a new deal he hopes to secure with the EU next week will “get food prices down” and put more money in the pockets of British exporters.
